column1: # Verified company job boards.  ats <TAB> slug <TAB> display name
# Every row here was confirmed live by src/discover.mjs — a guessed slug fails
# silently forever, and a dead board looks exactly like "no new jobs".
# Add companies with:  node src/discover.mjs "Company Name"
# Identity, not just liveness: a slug can resolve to a different company with the
# same name. "fellow" is a San Francisco coffee brand, not Fellow.app Ottawa, and
# "sanctuary" is not Sanctuary AI. Both were rejected. Confirm a board is the right
# company by reading its job locations before adding a row.
